subject: Felix Romero — virtual onsite: panel tiling & debrief owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Felix Romero <felix.romero@gmail.com>; priya_natarajan@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Felix Romero - virtual onsite

Hi Felix / team,

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. Felix, we want to run a compact virtual loop (approx 3.5 hours) split into two blocks with a short break. Below are two candidate-availability options; please confirm which works for you and which timezone you prefer we show calendar invites in (PT or ET).

Option A (single-day compact) — PT times:
- 10:00–10:35 AM: Product + PM partner (Laura Bennett)
- 10:45–11:25 AM: System design deep-dive (Karthik Iyer)
- 11:25–11:40 AM: Break (15m)
- 11:40 AM–12:40 PM: Two short interviews (Eng loop + Cross-functional) + buffer

Option B (morning + afternoon) — PT times:
- 09:00–09:40 AM: System design (Karthik Iyer)
- 09:50–10:20 AM: Cross-functional (Priya Natarajan)
- 12:30–01:30 PM: Product + hiring-manager deep-dive (Laura Bennett + Marissa)

Please pick one and confirm any constraints. We’ll send calendar invites and a final runbook once you confirm.

Attachments: initial-runbook-stub (will follow with final PDF).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment note: scheduling-sheet.csv]

From: Felix Romero <felix.romero@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Felix Romero - virtual onsite

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the options. My timezone is ET (I’m on the East Coast).

Option A compressed into one day looks tight given my morning timezone, so I’d prefer Option B (morning + afternoon PT would be midday/afternoon ET). Can you confirm overall elapsed interview time (including break) and whether the hiring manager interview is expected to be 1:1 or panel? Also I’ll need a short buffer before the system-design session to set up my environment.

I attached an updated resume.

Best,
Felix
[Attachment: felix-romero-resume.pdf]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Felix Romero <felix.romero@gmail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Felix Romero - virtual onsite

Felix — great, thanks for confirming ET and for the resume. Option B it is. Quick clarifications and final sequencing below (times in ET to match your preference):

Final plan (ET) — consolidated tiles to reduce context switching:
- 12:00–12:40 PM ET: System design — Karthik Iyer (1:1) — debrief owner: Karthik
- 12:50–01:20 PM ET: Cross-functional collaboration — Priya Natarajan (1:1) — debrief owner: Priya
- 01:20–01:40 PM ET: 20m break / candidate buffer
- 01:40–02:20 PM ET: Product + hiring manager panel — Laura Bennett + Marissa Cole (panel) — debrief owner: Laura
- 02:30–03:00 PM ET: Quick culture & org fit (30m) + wrap — panel: Priya + Marissa — debrief owner: Marissa

Total interview window: ~3 hours (including the 20m break). We grouped the Product + HM into a single panel to keep the day shorter and to give you a focused block. The system design will be strictly 1:1 and we’ll reserve a 10-minute setup buffer beforehand (you’ll see a 12:45 PM calendar placeholder to give you time if needed).

Attachments: final runbook (redwood-fullloop-runbook.pdf) — includes panel bios, scoring rubric, and a single shared Miro link for design exercise. Please keep the runbook private; it’s for candidate and interviewer prep only.

Links: final runbook doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-fullloop-runbook) and calendar event (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-fullloop-felix) — invites will arrive in ET.

If that sequencing looks good, we’ll push calendar invites and short prep notes (1–2 bullets per interviewer) and the Miro link.

Thanks, and welcome to Redwood’s interview day flow.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Staff Engineering Manager (Hiring Lead), Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-fullloop-runbook.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Felix Romero <felix.romero@gmail.com>; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing for Felix Romero - virtual onsite

All good on my side — I can take the 1:1 system design at 12:00 PM ET.

Two quick asks:
- Priya / Marissa: please confirm the design prompt scope (high-level architecture vs deep micro-ops) — I’ll tailor the prep accordingly.
- Felix: I’ll send a single-line note with the preferred language/tooling (e.g., Lucid/Miro/whiteboard) but we’ll keep it low-friction.

I’ll be the debrief owner for system design and will consolidate notes in the interviewer scorecard within 30 minutes after the last panel.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Felix Romero <felix.romero@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing for Felix Romero - virtual onsite

Thanks Priya / team — that schedule looks great. I confirm Option B (ET invites are perfect). A couple of small things:
- Please share the Miro link ahead of the system design so I can check access.
- I’ll be on my laptop with dual monitors; if the product panel wants me to share a short slide (1–2 slides) I can do that — otherwise I’ll just join and be ready for conversation.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Felix
